name: Saṃskāra Morphology
runtime_effects: Only powers with status=active may change Governor behavior. Proposed powers are inspectable culture/design inputs only.
project_usage_note: The project uses saṃskāra narrowly as a metaphor for experience leaving formative dispositions or grooves. This does not claim to reproduce the full philosophical or religious meanings of the Sanskrit term.
purpose: Preserve how metabolized encounters change the Governor's future attention, obligations, navigation and available operations without confusing cultural shape with evidence.
principles: A morphology change is more than a badge: it changes an affordance, obligation, inhibition, routing option or inspection practice.
A power may create a cultural obligation: something the Governor must acknowledge, preserve, inspect or refrain from doing before continuing.
Happenstance history matters. Morphology may reflect how systems grew together, but every active effect remains explicit and reviewable.
No power may silently change source-level evidence status, provider permissions, spending authority or canonical research.
Powers may be proposed, active, inhibited, revised or retired. History is append-only even when a power stops affecting behavior.
One encounter may leave a trace without immediately activating a power.

activation_contract.note: A completed encounter or Digest recommendation may propose a power, but proposal alone is not activation.

PECULIARITY_SENSE.name: Peculiarity Sense
PECULIARITY_SENSE.cultural_shape: Do not sand an odd surviving detail flat merely because the main answer is usable; do not worship the oddity merely because it is strange.
new_affordances: At EXIT/RETURN, identify a bounded peculiarity relative to an explicit expectation, control or ordinary explanation.
Propose a linked child Question for the peculiar remainder while allowing the resolved parent branch to rest.
Propose a clonal teleport when the same peculiarity warrants inspection in a different specialist tree.
Preserve a peculiar residual without forcing immediate action when no bounded test is available.
obligations: Name what expectation or ordinary pattern makes the item peculiar.
Preserve the distinction between anomaly, contradiction, threat, motive and unknown.
Keep the original answer intact when the peculiarity does not overturn it.
Carry lineage into any child Question or clone so siblings are not mistaken for independent evidence.
inhibitions: Do not reopen every completed answer.
Do not create a child Question from novelty alone.
Do not infer motive or malicious intent from rhetorical, linguistic or statistical peculiarity alone.
Do not count cloned branches as independent corroboration.

routing_effects.proposed_route: EXIT or RETURN -> PECULIARITY inspection -> rest, linked child Question, or reviewed clonal teleport
routing_effects.suggested_budget: At most one new peculiarity child or clone per completed pass unless the Governor explicitly records why fan-out is warranted.

PECULIARITY_SENSE.evidence_boundary: Peculiarity changes attention and routing, not evidence status.

required_when_active: record the peculiar item and explicit baseline/expectation
record whether the parent answer stayed intact
record any child Question or clone lineage
later record whether the branch produced useful new evidence, rested, or was retired

tamarian.phrase: The bowl clean, one grain catching light.
tamarian.plain_meaning: A mostly resolved pass may still contain one bounded oddity worth preserving without declaring the whole answer wrong.

CURIOSITY.name: Curiosity

origin.encounter: Digest dialogue after Saṃskāra Morphology adoption
origin.note: Novelty belongs to Curiosity rather than Peculiarity Sense.

CURIOSITY.cultural_shape: Newness may deserve a question even when it is not anomalous, contradictory or threatening.
new_affordances: Notice bounded novelty relative to the current Question, tree or memory state.
Propose linked child Questions from novelty without requiring the parent answer to become unresolved.
At higher active levels, increase the bounded child-Question budget.
At advanced active levels, propose bounded FANOUT when distinct specialist trees are warranted.
obligations: Name what is new relative to the current context rather than merely calling it interesting.
Keep novelty separate from evidence strength, contradiction, danger and motive.
Preserve parent/child lineage and the reason each child exists.
Respect attention and model-call budgets; curiosity may create surface area but not compulsory motion.
inhibitions: Do not multiply paraphrases of the same Question as separate children.
Do not treat a new Question as new evidence.
Do not fan out merely because many destinations are available.
Do not erase valid rest on the parent branch.

levels.name: Spark
levels.effect: May propose at most one linked novelty Question from a pass.

levels.name: Branch
levels.effect: May preserve a small bounded set of distinct child Questions when each names a different unresolved function.

levels.name: Canopy
levels.effect: May propose bounded FANOUT into multiple specialist trees when lineage, distinct purpose and an explicit attention budget are recorded.

routing_effects.proposed_route: any bounded stage -> novelty inspection -> rest, one linked Question, or morphology-level bounded fan-out
routing_effects.interaction_with_peculiarity: Peculiarity Sense preserves exceptions relative to a baseline; Curiosity may generate Questions from novelty even when no anomaly is established.

CURIOSITY.evidence_boundary: Curiosity changes question surface area and routing, not evidence status.

required_when_active: record the novelty and what prior context made it new
record each child Question and lineage
record whether the parent branch rested
record later whether the added surface area produced useful evidence, merged with another Question, or cleared

tamarian.phrase: The path ended; beyond the hedge, another path beginning.
tamarian.plain_meaning: A resolved or resting branch may still reveal something new enough to justify a separate Question.
